description: River level readings at one gauge since a time (default the last 24 hours, up to 7 days back), with the lowest and highest point, change since the start and whether the river is rising, falling or steady over the last hour. Answers "has the river peaked yet" for flood watchers and anglers. Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API. The series is thinned to a manageable number of points; it is not a forecast. (cost: 1 credit)

points.description: integer, optional, max points in the returned series, 2-100, default 24

since.description: string, optional, ISO date-time (UTC if no offset) or YYYY-MM-DD within the last 7 days, default 24 hours ago

station_id.description: string, required, Environment Agency station reference, e.g. 2200TH

name: river_level_history
